user.title: Set up When to Ventilate
user.description: Create the integration now, optionally with a default reference climate.

default_reference.title: Choose the reference area
default_reference.description: A reference is an area whose air is compared with your rooms, typically a balcony or outside area.

error.invalid_humidity_sensor: Select a sensor with the humidity device class.

user.title: Choose a room
user.description: Select the Home Assistant area to configure.

details.title: Room climate
details.description: Configure the sensors and reference for {area_name}. Without custom hysteresis values, the global values apply: relative humidity {global_relative_humidity_on}/{global_relative_humidity_off} %, absolute difference {global_absolute_humidity_on}/{global_absolute_humidity_off} g/m³.

reconfigure.title: Configure room
reconfigure.description: Update the sensors and reference for {area_name}. Without custom hysteresis values, the global values apply: relative humidity {global_relative_humidity_on}/{global_relative_humidity_off} %, absolute difference {global_absolute_humidity_on}/{global_absolute_humidity_off} g/m³.

hysteresis.title: Custom hysteresis values for {area_name}
hysteresis.description: Set the individual humidity thresholds for this room. The cooling-protection hysteresis remains global.

configure_hysteresis.title: Configure ventilation thresholds
configure_hysteresis.description: These global values apply to every room without custom hysteresis values. The minimum temperature always remains room-specific.
